prayerExcerpt.en-US: You have made us for yourself, O Lord, and our heart is restless until it rests in you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Fizeste-nos para ti, Senhor, e o nosso coração está inquieto enquanto não repousa em ti.

meta.face: A mature man around 45 with a warm olive-brown North African (Berber) complexion, close-cropped dark hair, a short dark beard, thoughtful ardent upward gaze.
meta.basis: North African origin; short dark beard and cropped hair as in the 6th-century Lateran fresco, his oldest portrait.

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
